name: Chino Hills Teen Advisory Board
what_you_do: Advise the Parks and Recreation Commission on youth programs. You share what teens need, help with youth events and volunteer with the city. The board has 20 students.
who_can_apply: You must be in grades 7 to 12. You must live in Chino Hills or go to a school in Chino Hills.
pay_detail: The program page does not list pay.
duration: One year. Meets the second Thursday of each month, September to May, at 6:00 p.m.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-27 opened in March 2026 and are now closed. The page says to check back next year. In 2025 the deadline was March 14. Dates for 2027-28 are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: The form is not open now, so check the city page next year. In 2025 the city asked for a typed form, brought in person to the Community Center at 14250 Peyton Drive.
notes: In 2025 the city took forms until the deadline or the first 60, so apply early. You can ask to serve one more term if you stay in good standing. Questions: Community Center, 909-364-2826.
